title: Training and validation curves
outcome: By the end, I can explain training and validation curves using a traced example and a stated limitation.
scenario: Plot training and validation loss for checkpoints before opening final cases.
given: Supplied checkpoint losses: epoch 1 train4, val3; epoch 2 train2, val2; epoch 3 train1, val2.5. Selection: smallest validation loss.
All inputs and outcomes in this worked example are invented classroom data; no real model run is claimed.

steps.label: Read validation curve
steps.detail: Validation loss falls3→2 then rises to2.5.

steps.label: Choose checkpoint
steps.detail: Select epoch 2, not epoch 3, under the declared validation criterion.

explanation: The training curve measures fit to examples used for learning. The validation curve measures a separate set used to choose a checkpoint. The final training loss is smallest here, but its validation loss has risen. Under the supplied selection rule, keep checkpoint two. A later final test must remain outside both learning and checkpoint selection.

counterfactual.prediction: Select epoch 3 under the unchanged criterion.
counterfactual.reason: Its measured validation loss is now below epoch 2’s2; the training curve alone never settled selection.

student_task: Can the original epoch 3 training loss 1 justify claiming best generalisation? Point to the relevant step in the picture, then write the changed result and the rule or evidence that supports it.
teacher_answer: No. Original validation loss 2.5 exceeded epoch 2’s2. Freeze the selected checkpoint before final evaluation. Changed-case check: Select epoch 3 under the unchanged criterion. Its measured validation loss is now below epoch 2’s2; the training curve alone never settled selection.
project_evidence: For your Image-pattern Network Investigation, save the input, procedure, observed result and limitation of this check. Label this worked example as practice; use a different, previously unreviewed case when checking independent understanding.
limits: A single curve has sampling and run variability; validation-selected checkpoints still require untouched final evidence.
